changelog:
- Added explicit permissions declaration for browser navigation, evaluation, network access, and Facebook credentials usage.
- Clarified authentication token usage: Facebook session tokens are accessed and used only for authenticated requests to facebook.com; they are not shared with any third party.
- Stated that all eval JS is statically generated from trusted scripts and user-supplied strings are never interpolated at runtime.
- Introduced user confirmation before bulk pagination when requesting more than 50 posts to prevent accidental large-scale scraping.
- Removed redundant or sample documentation files (e.g., skill-card.md) for better maintainability.
summary: Scrapes posts from a Facebook group given a group URL, sort order, and desired count — returns structured post metadata including post_id, permalink, author, timestamp, body text, images/videos, reaction counts, reaction type breakdown, comment count, and share count. Use when: user wants to scrape/
